recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No source follow-up is needed for FHIR-13953 unless a later work-group decision changes the Patient $match input model.
issue_request: FHIR-13953 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 Patient Administration change request for [base]/Patient/$match. It reported that the input parameter named "resource" was mandatory while its documentation said, "If a patient record is not provided, then one or more of the other parameters must be provided," implying that the patient resource could be optional. The accepted resolution said the sentence came from a previous version of the operation, was incorrect, and would be removed.
initial_application: Git commit 9ec491238348d5da09f2d1d85646a96723e4fcba, whose subject lists tracker 13953, removed the misleading sentence from source/patient/patient-spreadsheet.xml in the Patient $match resource-parameter documentation. The 2021 source refactor commit 33b409a4b6d40e9ad2973ee35790c7d69bf602c0 later created source/patient/operationdefinition-Patient-match.xml while preserving that corrected wording.
additional_context: Patient is active in source/fhir.ini and source/patient/list-Patient-operations.xml references OperationDefinition/Patient-match, so the current OperationDefinition is in build scope. The current resource parameter has min=1 and max=1, and its documentation no longer includes the obsolete optional-resource sentence. Later Patient $match commits adjusted unrelated operation details and did not reintroduce the removed sentence. Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no conflicting final decision or relevant community discussion for this wording.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current source already satisfies the applied Jira decision.
